verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Jitsu serves an llms.txt at docs.jitsu.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which opens with a product summary aimed at LLMs. Several doc pages are also served as raw .md files (mcp.md, api.md, jitsu-cli.md), so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and its coverage, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus variant (the probe content is truncated).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Jitsu is an open-source data integration platform and a self-hostable alternative to Segment.
